name: new-term-radar
description: Three skills that find the names of new AI models, products and repositories as they surface, and size the search terms behind them with Google Ads volume and DataForSEO Trends, an estimate of Google search interest.

glasser_api_key.title: Glasser API key
glasser_api_key.description: First choice for the radar's paid data: Google Ads volumes, DataForSEO Trends, Google results, domain data, Reddit, YouTube and the X posts. recent_leads works without it. A key: https://link.glasser.ai/JasonZhuX (a referral link: the author gets a reward if you sign up through it)

aisa_api_key.title: AIsa API key
aisa_api_key.description: For what Glasser does not sell: site: searches and the model that judges names. Without a Glasser key, all the paid data goes through it too. A key: https://aisa.one

radar_llm_base_url.title: Model endpoint (optional)
radar_llm_base_url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the name judge, in place of AIsa's chat, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. Leave empty to use AIsa's.

radar_llm_api_key.title: Model API key (optional)
radar_llm_api_key.description: The key for the model endpoint above.

radar_llm_model.title: Model name (optional)
radar_llm_model.description: The model to call at that endpoint, in place of the models in config.json.

goanyapi_api_key.title: GoAnyAPI API key (optional)
goanyapi_api_key.description: Optional: what people searched together with each name, and one country's daily Trends series. A key: https://goanyapi.com
